title: Virtual Compute: immediate refund — assessment evidence
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute immediate refund — Read approved assessment amount from the one approved eligible refund assessment for the exact original payment; that assessment must name the current filed request. This scope permits exactly one such eligible assessment for the payment across current and historical records, so another request assessment on the same payment is excluded from this scope.
